profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, New York. According to its own site, IBM develops enterprise software and cloud services for governance, risk management, and compliance. The company reported revenue of $67.535 billion for the year ending December 31, 2025.

IBM's main AI governance product is IBM OpenPages with Watson, described on its site as a scalable, AI-powered unified GRC platform available on any cloud or on-premises. The platform includes an interactive workspace called the GRC Canvas for modeling processes and risks with live data, embedded AI to automate classification and issue creation, and support for integrating watsonx.ai or third-party AI models through flexible APIs. IBM also offers IBM watsonx.governance, an AI lifecycle governance tool for model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation that was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. Both products support the company's broader IBM watsonx enterprise AI platform.

The site highlights that OpenPages includes an MCP Server to enable AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects, and notes a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning. IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape for AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance in 2026. IBM has 342 legal exposures tracked in New York.
